name: Shenthul
summary: In Orgrimmar's Cleft of Shadow, Shenthul trains rogues and serves the Shattered Hand. He directs covert work across Kalimdor and brings promising rogues into its ranks.

sections.title: Eyes in the Chasm
sections.body: Shenthul trains rogues in Orgrimmar's Cleft of Shadow. While warriors and shamans march openly across Durotar, he teaches stealth, ambush, and subterfuge. His students learn fieldcraft and lethal arts for work in Kalimdor's harsh wilderness and unforgiving politics.

sections.title: The Shattered Hand
sections.body: Shenthul speaks for the Shattered Hand, once an orcish clan and now the Horde's intelligence network and secret service. He describes it as a watchful presence across Kalimdor, investigating, judging, and carrying out its own sentences. Pragmatic and independent of shifting politics, Shenthul reminds outsiders that the Shattered Hand existed before Warchief Thrall took power and will endure after him.

sections.title: Covert Fieldwork
sections.body: Shenthul directs covert work in contested territories. He sends operatives to infiltrate hostile interests and practice lockpicking on the Venture Company's locked supply boxes around Windshear Crag. Recruits face demanding trials, and when poisons strike his field agents, Shenthul makes sure they find remedies before the toxins prove fatal.

faq.answer: Shenthul trains jungle troll rogues in the Cleft of Shadow beneath Orgrimmar and works for the Shattered Hand.
Shenthul can be found in the Cleft of Shadow, a cavern complex reached through Orgrimmar's darker tunnels.

faq.q: What is Shenthul's connection to the Shattered Hand?
faq.answer: Shenthul works for the Shattered Hand, the Horde's covert intelligence and assassin guild, and recruits rogues into its ranks.

faq.q: What does Shenthul think of Warchief Thrall?
faq.answer: Shenthul says the Shattered Hand existed before Thrall took power and will endure after him. He puts the guild's work and the Horde's security above shifting politics.

faq.q: What missions does Shenthul offer to rogues?
faq.answer: Shenthul guides rogues through initiation trials and covert infiltration work. He also directs them to practice lockpicking on Venture Company's locked supply boxes around Windshear Crag in the Stonetalon Mountains.

faq.q: Does Shenthul assist with rogue poisons?
faq.answer: Yes. When field agents face lethal poisons, Shenthul directs them to Hinott for remedies.

angles.text: As a rogue in Orgrimmar, you can learn from Shenthul, face initiation trials, and take on covert assignments.
Beneath Orgrimmar, Shenthul directs the Horde's covert intelligence work against threats within and beyond its ranks.
As a troll, you can see how Shenthul, a jungle troll, has joined the Shattered Hand, once an orcish clan.
